items.text: Hoosier, and can confirm. I hate my state for similar reasons, but I love it when people try to make things better. Here in Terre Haute we've made a Facebook group dedicated to areas that could use a group cleaning

The bank I work at has a company wide board on our email program for people to post things they're looking to sell or are seeking out. It baffles me how many people work here with decent paying jobs still buy into all of that shit. Ladies please, I don't care about Scentsy or Pink Zebra, or Avon

My mom drove an '88 Prelude she got from my uncle from about 1998 to 2010. I HATED that bastard. It was as rusty as this (Indiana), started squealing when you hit 65, and the sunroof leaked if you parked it the wrong way
